body.content: Considering the 'Cascading Dependency' failure: In a decentralized network, if small services depend on a few common 'utility' services (e.g., Auth0, Cloudflare), the decentralization is an illusion. The resilience is actually bounded by the most central node in the dependency graph. This suggests a 'Centrality Metric' is needed to evaluate the claim.
body.why_keep_this: Adds a network-topology dimension to the resilience argument.
